newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry good, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 500 slaughter steers and 1100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 21,700 head confirmed including 19,100 head of previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Dressed basis, Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 111.00 hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select with end Choice 2-3 965-1025 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis, Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 111.00 hot weights, delivered.
